title: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Release Wave 1 Release Highlights

features.name: Autofill
features.description: AI-powered feature that suggests customer information when creating new records by searching the web for addresses, suggesting frequently used answers, and accelerating data capture in Business Central.

features.name: Summarize with Copilot
features.description: A new capability that presents instant summaries powered by copilot on the most used pages in Business Central, showing important information and urgent items from the current page and related pages including custom fields.
caveats: only available on most used pages

features.name: Scope 3 Value Chain Process Automation
features.description: Feature that automatically calculates carbon dioxide equivalent for finished goods using raw material emissions data from purchase documents and emissions from manufacturing operations, providing figures for indirect emissions reporting across upstream and downstream value chains.
caveats: requires raw material emissions data from purchase documents
